notes: Each worksheet is an independent experimental session.
The workbook has no timestamp column; sample rate and units come from supplied source metadata, not workbook fields.
Only six DOF motion columns are present; no directly measured gyro columns.

1.1.Notes: non-self propulsion test but with the propeller (Not available)

5.1.Notes: the rest runs are with same speed of 1.581

13.1.Notes: turned off lasso acqiure late real values till 100sec

36.1.Notes: repeat same run again because of so many noises

40.2.Notes: many noises at 0 degree of rudder angle

units.Time Stamp: s, elapsed/relative value (starts vary by run)
units.Delta Angle X/Y/Z: degrees/s per CSV unit row; field name says Delta Angle, units row says angular rate

notes: Every IMU CSV is a separate run; no runs concatenated.
Lasso matching is by run number only; timestamp synchronization was not inferred.
